title: The ⌘J badge shows the model, lets you change it and re-run
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData, open a draft, press ⌘J and run Improve writing
Click the On this Mac badge next to the thumbs
Click View trace, go back, then click Re-run on this model
expected: The popover shows the model behind this answer with its time and tokens, the model list for ⌘J with Mail's default checked and marked Default (no Automatic choice), models that can't be used yet greyed out with the reason, a line saying the choice is used for every future ⌘J in a draft, why it is used, and the trace. Re-run closes the popover and writes a new version with the checked model.
